defect_title: Credential Stuffing Bot bypassed login rate-limiting
defect_description: Production security monitoring detected 25,000 automated login attempts against customer accounts in 5 minutes without triggering lockouts or CAPTCHA enforcement. Credential stuffing compromised 3 accounts.

defect_title: Negative cart total via coupon stacking allows free order dispatch
defect_description: Customers stacked multiple promotional codes ('FALL50' + 'WELCOME20' + '$15OFF') simultaneously, resulting in cart balances of -$15.00. The order completed and warehouse systems dispatched items without payment.

defect_title: Duplicate card charges on mobile network latency retries
defect_description: During a mobile cellular latency spike, users clicked 'Pay Now' repeatedly. Concurrent payment requests bypassed non-atomic in-memory idempotency locks, charging customers' credit cards twice for a single order.

defect_title: Wallet double-spending race condition on concurrent withdrawal requests
defect_description: A user executed 8 concurrent automated API withdrawal requests in parallel for $200 each against a wallet balance of $200. Because row-level database locks were omitted, all requests read $200, resulting in a -$1,400 balance loss.

defect_title: Cumulative rounding variance in daily cross-border bank settlement
defect_description: The clearinghouse reconciliation job reported an unreconciled $4,830 variance at end-of-day. Standard floating-point truncation in high-volume fractional penny micro-transactions caused cumulative arithmetic drift across 800,000 transactions.
